question: What dark-colored object is contemplated after resorting to the place of the yoginī?
premises: The practitioner resorts to the place of the yoginī.
A specific object is contemplated there.
That object is dark and black in color.
inference: Having resorted to the yoginī's place, one contemplates the dark, black-colored form.
plain_english: Having resorted to the place of the yoginī, one contemplates the dark, black-colored form.
